description: Source code for V4L2 VP9 video decoder delegate implementation, including classes and functions for handling VP9 picture processing, decoder submission, and interaction with V4L2 device controls.

classes.name: V4L2VP9Picture
classes.description: A class representing a VP9 picture with an associated V4L2 decode surface.

classes.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP9
classes.description: A delegate class for handling VP9 decoding via V4L2 interface on Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.name: V4L2VP9Picture::AsV4L2VP9Picture
methods.description: Returns the object as a V4L2VP9Picture pointer.

methods.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP9::CreateVP9Picture
methods.description: Creates a new VP9 picture with a V4L2 decode surface.

methods.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP9::SubmitDecode
methods.description: Submits a VP9 picture for decoding, configuring V4L2 controls and buffers.

methods.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP9::OutputPicture
methods.description: Handles outputting a decoded VP9 picture.

methods.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP9::GetFrameContext
methods.description: Retrieves the frame context; not implemented.

methods.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP9::NeedsCompressedHeaderParsed

methods.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP9::SupportsContextProbabilityReadback
methods.description: Indicates if context probability readback is supported.
